text:
Hi, I’m Mina Castellan, and I specialize in Excel-based data work, data cleaning, and clear reporting. With 5 years of experience in SQL, Excel, Power BI, Google Sheets, data analysis, dashboard work, and data visualization, I’d be glad to support your data entry needs with a focus on accuracy and well-structured spreadsheets.

In a recent project, I built a Power BI sales KPI dashboard for Marlowe Furniture using Power BI, DAX, SQL Server, and Excel. I replaced 14 separate Excel sales reports with one star-schema report, which also reduced monthly close reporting from 3 days to 4 hours. That work required careful data handling, consistent formatting, and strong attention to detail—exactly the kind of discipline that helps in high-accuracy Excel work.

I also completed a parent survey analysis for Riverbend Education Fund, where I cleaned and weighted a 4,200-response survey in Excel and supported the board with the findings. The work helped produce 3 findings that were adopted in the next funding plan. That project reinforced my ability to work through large datasets carefully, keep records organized, and verify data before it’s used.

For your role, I can help with Excel data entry, database updates, product listings, sales lead lists, daily deposits, and accuracy verification. I’m comfortable working in spreadsheets, keeping data clean and consistent, and making sure entries are organized in a way that’s easy to review and use later. If needed, I can also help improve the structure of the sheet so the data stays manageable over time.

I’d approach the work with a strong focus on precision, speed, and reliable formatting. If you’d like, I can also help spot inconsistencies while entering the data so fewer corrections are needed later.

What kind of Excel file or data source will I be working from for this job?
